subtitle: Processing only what's new, not the whole table every run

caption: The highest already-processed value of an ever-increasing column — read it before pulling new rows.

code:
MERGE INTO staging.orders_cleaned AS tgt
USING (SELECT * FROM raw.orders
       WHERE loaded_at > :last_loaded_ts) AS src
ON tgt.order_id = src.order_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET tgt.order_total = src.order_total
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (order_id, order_total)
    VALUES (src.order_id, src.order_total);
caption: Same MERGE syntax you already know from T-SQL — updates changed rows, inserts new ones.
